meta.governance: Krishak Samaj is the thematic bridge. IFS details live on the Integrated Farming page. Mission numbers live on The Mission.

lede: The 2026 Durga Puja theme names the agricultural community. The Puja stays the cultural door. Integrated Farming is the livelihood story that follows.
legend: This page is people and purpose. The farm-as-system diagram lives on Integrated Farming. Funding arithmetic lives on The Mission.

why.body: Ram Sir named Krishak Samaj as the 2026 Durga Puja theme: an experience on the BKS platform that connects culture with mobilising the agricultural community toward Integrated Farming Systems. That is direction, not a finished programme and not a second brand.

farmer.body: The farmer — the annadata — must never feel like a secondary object here. This site speaks of farmers we want to support. It does not call people beneficiaries, and it does not promise that anyone has already received seed funding.

ecosystem.body: Public research in West Bengal treats farming as more than a crop plot: animals, ponds, trees, compost, soil and water are planned so one residue becomes another input. That is an institutional idea, not a list of BKS farms.

themes.title: Community
themes.body: A public Puja is neighbourhood work. That is Bengal’s fact, not a BKS membership drive.

themes.title: Seasonality
themes.body: Sharadiya Puja sits in the harvest season. Nabapatrika binds the rite to nine plants.

themes.title: Food
themes.body: Bhog is a shared kitchen after offering. Whether BKS cooks is not decided here.

themes.title: Bengal
themes.body: Clay, dhak, homecoming. The Samaj is a guest in that culture.

themes.title: Livelihoods and craft
themes.body: Artisan labour is a seasonal economy. No unnamed kumor is exhibited here.

themes.title: Knowledge on the main site
themes.body: Deeper Integrated Farming reference copy is intended for the BKS West Bengal website. No URL is invented here.
